releases.notes:
# Silkworms v0.6.0 — Survival Beta

This is the first Survival Beta release of Silkworms & Moths.

## Features

- Full lifecycle: Silkworm → Cocoon → Silk Moth
- Natural silkworm spawning in lush cave-style environments
- Hanging cocoons that hatch into silk moths
- Tameable silk moth companions
- Rideable tamed moths
- Silkworm Bucket support
- Subtle silkworm and cocoon variants
- Safe-removal commands for world cleanup
- Tamed moths convert into vanilla Allays during cleanup

## Notes

This release is intended for survival testing. The main gameplay loop is complete and tested, but the mod is still marked as beta while more polish and compatibility feedback are collected.

## Minecraft / Loader

- Minecraft: 1.21.11
- Loader: Fabric
- License: MIT

## Important

Do not remove the mod from an active world without following the cleanup instructions in `COMPATIBILITY_AND_REMOVAL.md`.
